title: Whose Story Does a Documentary Tell

paragraphs.en: A student filmmaker decided to embark on a documentary about a coastal village rebuilding after conflict. She hoped to embed the voices of residents in the story, rather than rely on a narrator to explain their lives. At the old fire station, a volunteer described how neighbors had worked to extinguish flames, fetch water, and haul furniture out of damaged homes. Visitors could bump into fragile equipment in the cramped room, so the crew kept its passage clear. The filmmaker would not mock an imperfect recollection or oppress a witness with repeated questions. People should not have to plead for control over a deeply personal account. When one speaker began to rub his tired eyes, she stopped recording and offered a break.
paragraphs.zh: 一位学生导演决定着手拍摄一个沿海村庄战后重建的纪录片。她希望将居民的声音融入故事，而不是依赖旁白解释他们的人生。在旧消防站，一位志愿者讲述邻里怎样扑灭火焰、取水，并从受损房屋搬出家具。狭小房间里的来访者可能撞到易损设备，因此摄制组保持通道畅通。导演不会嘲笑不完美的回忆，也不以反复提问压迫证人。人们不应需要苦苦请求，才能控制极其私人的叙述。一位讲话者开始揉疲惫的眼睛时，她停止录制，让他休息。

paragraphs.en: A dramatic shot of broken windows might invite audiences to imagine the moment violence would smash a household's security. Yet images could also suck complexity out of the story and sway viewers through emotion alone. The filmmaker began to browse local records before choosing a clip. A carpenter offered to carve a replacement sign for the school, and children helped compile photographs of its repair. They might gasp at a damaged wall or graze a hand against rough wood, but their daily lives included much more than ruins. The director declined to nominate a single resident as the village's hero because rebuilding had depended on many ordinary people.
paragraphs.zh: 破窗的戏剧性镜头可能让观众想象暴力打碎家庭安全感的一刻。然而影像也可能吸走故事的复杂性，仅靠情绪影响观众。导演开始先浏览当地记录，再选择片段。一位木匠主动雕刻学校的新标牌，孩子帮助整理修缮照片。他们可能看到残墙时倒吸一口气，或用手擦过粗糙木面，但日常生活远不止废墟。导演拒绝指定某位居民为全村英雄，因为重建依靠了许多普通人。

paragraphs.en: One interview concerned an assault during the conflict. The witness remembered a punch, a blast nearby, and an order to surrender. A guard had tried to eject families from a shelter. The filmmaker used a tick on her notes to mark details requiring confirmation. Her obligation was to uphold the witness's dignity while distinguishing memory from established evidence. She could envisage using the account, but first needed to flush out inconsistencies through documents, not aggressive interrogation. An exhausted person might groan or isolate himself after speaking. No camera should pierce that privacy merely because distress could make a scene more powerful.
paragraphs.zh: 一次访谈涉及冲突中的袭击。证人记得拳击、附近爆炸，以及投降命令。一位卫兵曾试图把家庭赶出避难所。导演在笔记上用勾号标出待核实细节。她有责任维护证人的尊严，同时区分记忆与已确立证据。她能设想使用这段讲述，但首先需借文献找出不一致处，而不是咄咄逼人的盘问。疲惫的人讲话后可能呻吟，或独自待着。镜头不应仅因为痛苦能使场景更有力量，就刺入这种隐私。

paragraphs.en: Accounts of a raid could tangle different events together. The film was bound by limited time, but to condense a complex life into suffering alone would crush its meaning. A neighbor might doze during a peaceful afternoon while a loose flag would flap above the rebuilt square. A child could grin as a carpenter raised a hammer. These ordinary images supplied an impetus to rethink the script. A resident who chose to moan about slow repairs was not necessarily ungrateful; criticism could nourish public accountability. The documentary needed to penetrate beyond easy categories, without allowing curiosity to become permission to poke into everything people wanted to keep private.
paragraphs.zh: 关于突袭的讲述可能把不同事件缠在一起。影片受时长限制，但将复杂人生仅浓缩为苦难，会压垮其意义。平静午后，邻居可能打盹，松动旗帜在修复的广场上方拍动。木匠举锤时，孩子也可能咧嘴笑。这些普通画面提供了重新思考剧本的动力。哀叹维修缓慢的居民未必忘恩负义，批评可以滋养公共问责。纪录片需要深入简单分类之外，却不能让好奇心变成刺探别人所有隐私的许可。

paragraphs.en: An editor suggested music that could rip the audience out of comfort. The filmmaker rejected it after watching an interview end with a quiet sigh. Her purpose was not to startle viewers into sympathy and then let them forget the village. Residents reviewed the portions concerning their own stories before release, and disagreements were recorded rather than hidden. The finished film contained difficult memories alongside ordinary work. It asked audiences to see recovery as a continuing process shaped by choices, resources, and relationships. That slower account offered fewer sensational moments, but a more truthful understanding of what it meant to rebuild a place and remain there.
paragraphs.zh: 一位剪辑师建议使用能把观众从舒适状态中撕扯出来的音乐。导演看见一次访谈以轻轻叹息结束后，拒绝了这个建议。她的目的不是把观众吓出同情，然后任他们忘掉村庄。上映前，居民检查与自己故事有关的部分，分歧也被记录而非隐藏。成片把艰难回忆与普通工作放在一起，让观众把复原看成受选择、资源和关系影响的持续过程。这种较缓慢的讲述缺少耸动瞬间，却更真实地解释了重建一处地方、并留下来生活意味着什么。
